observations: The prior audit provides no Accepted authority model and explicitly requires a new preregistered campaign.
The research-execution charter defines the imported lifecycle and artifact-status taxonomy but is itself Provisional.
The proof-assurance taxonomy defines assurance labels used by the theorem/proof-status register but has no explicit charter status.

The repository registers proof evidence through theorem metadata, lemma metadata, the dependency registry, verifier-required T-series proof objects, JSON and YAML path fields, self-identifying proof records, and Lean paths.
A proof owner pattern does not establish proof status or authority-bearing designation.
The proof-artifact status manifest requires its own independent Acceptance decision in addition to per-entry decisions.
Recency cannot resolve equal-priority contradiction; unresolved contradiction must fail closed to Unknown.
A non-self-activating Research candidate can encode these constraints while bootstrap authority remains Unknown.
